title: The Train We Did Not Catch
titleZh: 我們沒趕上的那班火車
summaryZh: 兩名旅客錯過山區末班火車後冷靜重排行程，意外找到結合公車與渡輪的替代路線。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: The doors closed while I was still coming down the stairs, so that was definitely our train.
sentences.zh: 我還在下樓梯時車門就關了，所以那肯定是我們的火車。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: And according to this board, it was also the last direct service to Harbor Town tonight.
sentences.zh: 而且按照這塊看板，那也是今晚前往港灣鎮的最後一班直達車。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I am sorry; I should not have gone back to the cafe for my charger.
sentences.zh: 對不起，我不該為了充電器回咖啡館。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: We can argue about the charger later, but right now we need somewhere to sleep or another route.
sentences.zh: 我們之後再為充電器爭論，現在得先找住宿或另一條路。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: The ticket office is closed, and the journey planner keeps showing an error.
sentences.zh: 售票處關了，行程規劃程式又一直顯示錯誤。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: There is a station map over here, and it shows a bus connection on the other side of the valley.
sentences.zh: 這裡有張車站地圖，上面顯示山谷另一側有接駁公車。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That bus goes to Lake Pier, not Harbor Town, so how does that help us?
sentences.zh: 那班公車是去湖畔碼頭，不是港灣鎮，這能怎麼幫上忙？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: The map shows an evening ferry from the pier, and its final stop is exactly where we are going.
sentences.zh: 地圖上顯示碼頭有晚間渡輪，終點正是我們要去的地方。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: The connection is only twelve minutes, which feels risky when we have luggage.
sentences.zh: 轉乘時間只有十二分鐘，帶著行李感覺很冒險。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: True, but the bus company says the driver can radio the ferry if the bus is slightly late.
sentences.zh: 沒錯，但公車公司說如果稍微誤點，司機可以用無線電通知渡輪。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Let me call our hotel before we buy anything, since the front desk may not stay open.
sentences.zh: 買票前讓我先打電話給飯店，因為櫃檯可能不會一直開著。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Good idea, and I will ask the bus driver to confirm that the ferry is actually running.
sentences.zh: 好主意，我會請公車司機確認渡輪今晚確實有開。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: The hotel will leave our key in a lockbox, so at least we do not have to rush after we arrive.
sentences.zh: 飯店會把鑰匙放在密碼盒裡，所以至少抵達後不用趕時間。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: The driver confirmed the ferry, and the combined ticket costs less than the train did.
sentences.zh: 司機確認渡輪有開，而且聯票比火車票還便宜。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: We may have missed the easy route, but crossing the lake at sunset sounds like a decent second choice.
sentences.zh: 我們也許錯過了最簡單的路線，但在日落時渡湖聽起來是個不錯的第二選擇。

questions.q: Why did the travelers miss their train?
options: They waited at the wrong platform
A went back for a charger

questions.q: How can they still reach Harbor Town that evening?
options: By taking a bus and then a ferry
By renting a car at the station
By taking a direct overnight bus

questions.q: How will they get into the hotel if they arrive late?
options: Another guest will let them in
Their key will be left in a lockbox
